question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Consciencious"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Conscientious" **which means wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly. (ईमानदार)

 
 
• **Example:** She is a **conscientious** student who always completes her assignments on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conscience** (अंतरात्मा): A person's moral sense of right and wrong.

 
 
• **Example:** His **conscience** wouldn't allow him to lie to his parents.
 
 
 
• **Conscious** (सचेत): Being aware of and responding to one's surroundings; awake.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **conscious** of the fact that everyone was staring at her.
 
 
 
• **Conspicuous** (प्रकट): Standing out so as to be clearly visible.
 
 
• **Example:** The red dress made her **conspicuous** in the crowd.
